name: board
title: Board
description: Generic kanban layout: a named, horizontally scrolling list of columns with headers, counts, actions, collapsible columns agents can toggle by name, groups and an empty slot. With a value, cards move between columns by drag, keyboard and agents (UI SDK's createTransfer).
docs: Give `Board` a `value` (or `defaultValue`), a `Record<string, string[]>` of card ids by column, and `onValueChange(lists, details)` to move cards: each `BoardColumn value` renders its list's ids from a children function as `BoardItem value`s (`variant` `card` or `plain`), in the draft's order while a card moves, and counts them. Space lifts a card, Up and Down place it, Left and Right change columns (`order` sets their order and `accepts(id, list)` skips a column that won't take it), Space drops it and Escape puts it back; a pointer drags a copy and scrolls the board near its edges. `details` has `key`, `from`, `to` and `index`. `handle` moves cards by their `BoardItemHandle` only, so a card's buttons stay clickable: the handles are one tab stop of their own, or with `handleFocus="card"` each is a control of a card that is already one of the board's stops (`BoardCard id render`). Agents get `move(id, list, index)` on the board's label (`agentMoves={false}` hides it); `labels`, `itemLabel` and `listLabel` set what screen readers hear.
